message:
I remember the last time we had a power outage, and it felt like a scene from a movie! My kids turned the living room into a cozy campout, complete with flashlights and blankets, while I was frantically searching for our power banks to keep our phones charged. I had to chuckle as they tried to outdo each other with their shadow puppets, reminding me that even in the dark, their creativity shines bright. 

It’s moments like these that show us the importance of being prepared — a little planning goes a long way! Keeping a few good flashlights and power banks handy can turn an unexpected blackout into an adventure rather than a hassle. What are your favorite tricks to keep the kids entertained during an outage?
